observations.behavior: Adds row_count parameter and allow_zero_row_skip flag to run_post_load_operations, and P1.F3.H1 passes allow_zero_row_skip=True. P1.F4.H2 replaces the TABLE_SIZE_STEP enabled gate with a new row-count-dependent gate. P1.F5.H3 adds a test for this behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow warehouse ingestion jobs to skip maintenance and publishing when no rows were written, potentially reducing unnecessary S3 and warehouse operations. This is a warehouse ingestion optimization, not a core PostHog product feature.
